an4.213:1.1: bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi catuhi? Kāyaduccaritena, . . . manoduccaritena, akataññūtā akataveditā. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.213:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi catuhi? Kāyasucaritena, . . . manosucaritena, kataññūtā kataveditā . . . . . . pe . . . pānātipāti
